goal: Keep every shared-db issue labelled exactly one of orchestrator or non-orchestrator: label on issue open/edit/reopen from the db-work-scope work_type, and sweep for blank or double-labelled issues on a schedule.
dispatcher: Albert Hazan chat session 2026-09-17 (issue label rule)
prohibited_actions: No database write or structure change of any kind
No change to any migration file or existing workflow
assumptions: An issue that already carries exactly one of the two labels keeps it unless the issue is newly opened or its body is edited
stop_conditions: Stop if the label rule would need to change an existing guard or workflow
